newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan construction sector shares lose ground.
newsitem.headline: Japan construction sector shares lose ground.

text.p: Shares in the construction sector lost ground on Friday due to worries that mounting problem loans in the real estate industry are likely to hurt their corporate profits, traders said.
Shares in Tobishima Corp was down 29 yen at 172 at midday, making it the third largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Aoki Corp was lost 25 yen to 170 at midday, ranked as the fourth-largest percentage loser. The level was below its previous low for the financial year at 195 marked on Thursday, and the volume, 3.505 million shares, was the third heaviest.
